name: public-projection-allowlist
description: Every readPublic route must project rows through a PUBLIC_/REDACTED_*_FIELDS allowlist (pickFields). Plan-runs was the last holdout; classification-as-data test (getTableColumns partition) plus over-the-wire spectator/operator tests under publicReadAuth is the proof shape to copy. Raw internal error strings (failureReason built from formatError) are withheld wholesale, never sanitized — state field carries the outcome.

name: event-projection-handle-censor
description: Internal runtime handles that the run projection withholds (REDACTED_RUN_FIELDS, warren-946f) can re-leak through the event transcript. Fix pattern: add the lowercased field name to SECRET_FIELD_SET in src/server/handlers/runs/event-projection.ts so the scrubber censors on key, keeping the event and its spectator-visible fields on the stream. burrowId censored in warren-5f59; burrowRunId is sibling warren-d8f4.

name: event-stream-handle-redaction
description: Public event-stream leaks of internal runtime handles are fixed by adding the lowercased key to SECRET_FIELD_SET in src/server/handlers/runs/event-projection.ts (censors on sight, keeps the event). Used for burrowId (warren-5f59) and burrowRunId (warren-d8f4).

name: event-projection-tiers
description: Public event-stream projection (src/server/handlers/runs/event-projection.ts) has three tiers: INTERNAL_EVENT_KINDS dropped whole, RAW_FAILURE_EVENT_KINDS (reap_failed/spawn_failed) body/log-split (step kept, message->[redacted], path stripped), everything else credential-scrubbed. Raw stderr and host paths match no credential shape, so failure payloads need the explicit per-kind sanitize - warren-cbd8.

Pre-auth preview-proxy 501 (preview_remote_worker) interpolated run.worker_id — a REDACTED_RUN_FIELDS member — into an anonymous body. Any surface below the auth gate must treat row columns as operator-only.
resolution: Dropped the workerId interpolation from the 501 message; preamble responses now carry the warren-e2a4 security-header baseline via withSecurityHeaders() in src/server/response.ts. Scenario 39 drives the preamble anonymously to hold it (warren-b0bd).
